title: Vercel Firebase sync/domain alignment
userReport: User reported the Vercel link showed an empty app and suspected local/server sync mismatch.

diagnosis.vercelUnauthState: Vercel production page had currentUser=null, syncStatus=관리자 인증 필요 · 로컬 모드, and local origin counts all zero.
diagnosis.notDataLoss: Firebase server data was not proven deleted; the Vercel origin had empty localStorage and could not authenticate to Firestore before admin login.
diagnosis.authFailure: signInAdmin on Vercel initially returned auth/unauthorized-domain.
diagnosis.serverBaseline: Prior remote count baseline exists with students=48, consults=17, inquiries=185, logs=13, payments=11, weekOverrideWeeks=14 in tmp/ultragoal-g001/data-counts-summary.json.

changes: Authorized vocal-studio-tan.vercel.app and the generated Vercel deployment domain in Firebase Auth authorizedDomains.
Added visible topSyncStatus in the app topbar so mobile explicitly shows 관리자 인증 필요 · 로컬 모드 instead of silently looking empty.
Improved admin login failure status for unauthorized-domain cases.
Bumped service worker cache version to vs-v2-2026-06-19-vercel-sync-fix.
Redeployed both Firebase Hosting and Vercel production after the sync/domain changes.

diffCheck.command: git diff --check -- index.html sw.js scripts/regression-gates.mjs vercel.json .vercelignore

authDomainProbe.afterAuthorizedDomainPatch: signInAdmin no longer rejected immediately with auth/unauthorized-domain; it reached OAuth popup/pending state in headless browser. User must complete Google admin login to load server data.

residualBlockers: Actual Firestore data display on Vercel still requires the user to complete Google admin login on that Vercel domain.
G004/G005 live split-write and Storage upload receipts still require a logged-in admin browser to run 관리자 검증 → 라이브 G004/G005 검증 and provide/copy the JSON receipt.
Future automatic Vercel Git deployments require committing/pushing local changes; direct production deployment is already current.
